protocol.selection: Revision 3 keeps the pinned 1.5B q4 model, introduces four-choice single-token constrained decoding and rejection-first guidance using exposed v1 failures as development evidence. The exposed 48 cases are a regression gate. Only after >90% regression accuracy, >=95% accepted precision, >=80% coverage and zero unsafe acceptances may the fresh balanced 96-case confirmation set run. No prompt or threshold tuning after confirmation.
